test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A project for purveying microcredit by linking Self-Help Groups (SHGs) with banks was launched by ________in 1992.
solution:
The correct answer is __**NABARD.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The origin of SHGs in India can be traced back to the establishment of the tone- **Employed Women’s Association( SEWA) in 1972.**
 
• In **1954, the Textile Labour Association (TLA)** of Ahmedabad formed its women’s sect in order to train the women belonging to families of shop workers in chops similar to sewing, knitting, etc.
 
• Ela Bhatt, who formed SEWA, organized poor and small-scale employed women workers similar to needlewomen, potters, peddlers, and others in the unorganized sector, with the idea of enhancing their inflows.
 
• **NABARD, in 1992, formed the SHG Bank relation design, which is the moment the world’s largest microfinance design.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SIDBI:**

 
 
• Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) is an independent financial institution aimed at aiding the growth and development of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) which contribute significantly to the national economy in terms of production, employment, and exports.
 
• It is a statutory body set up under an act of the Indian Parliament in 1990.
 
 
 
• **RRB:**
 
 
• The Regional Rural Banks in India are the Commercial Banks operating in various rural areas of the country. IBPS conducts the exam for the recruitment of Officers or Office Assistants in various RRBs.
 
 
 
• **IRMA:**
 
 
• The IRMA standard offers the only third-party certification of industrial-scale mine sites for all mined materials that are governed equitably by the private sector, local communities, civil society, and workers.
